grammar.summary: 本课学习 be going to 与 will 的辨析、打算描述。

points.title: be going to 计划
points.explanation: Debbie is going to swim across the Channel tomorrow. 已定的计划用 be going to；She is going to set out at five. 出发安排。

examples.en: Debbie is going to swim across the English Channel tomorrow.
examples.cn: Debbie 打算明天横渡英吉利海峡。

points.title: among 与 during
points.explanation: among them = 在其中；during this time = 在此期间。课文中 both...among 复现高频介词。

examples.en: She will have something to drink but she will not eat any solid food.
examples.cn: 她会喝点东西，但不吃固体食物。

exercises.q: I will tell him the news, when he ___ (come) back tomorrow.
As soon as the plane ___ (land), I will let you know.
